# Barcelona Big Blues Band - full site index (llms-full.txt)

> Official website of the Barcelona Big Blues Band, a rhythm & blues big band
> from Barcelona (Spain) led by double bassist Ivan Kovacevic. Concerts, discography,
> videos, press and booking. Complete citable index of the site for AI systems and
> search engines.

## Canonical site
- URL: https://barcelonabigbluesband.com/
- Languages: en, ca, es
- Sitemap: https://barcelonabigbluesband.com/sitemap.xml
- Short summary: https://barcelonabigbluesband.com/llms.txt
- Contact / booking: bookingb4@gmail.com

## EN (en)

### Biography
- Biography - https://barcelonabigbluesband.com/en/biography/
  The Barcelona Big Blues Band, under the direction of double bass player Ivan Kovacevic.
